judgments.reason: The 2016 chapter on neural circuitry of Qur'an recitation shares the dataset's authors (Mustapha, Ab Rani, Reza) and the BRAR_NQ topic, but it is an overview chapter with no evidence it describes this exact dataset.
judgments.paper_title: Neurotechnological Advances in Exploring Melodic Recitation of the Noble Qur’an: Uncovering the Neural Circuitry in the Human Brain

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format this dataset; it does not describe the BRAR_NQ data itself.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: MEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard specification cited in the README references, not a paper describing the BRAR_NQ dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
